name: Sample Agent
description: The worked example of a catalogue entry: a subagent that declares neither an input nor an output schema.

name: requirements-analyzer
description: Analyzes a spec or change request against the codebase to determine task type, work scale (small/medium/large), affected files, UI impact, constraints, and open questions. Takes requirements text and optional context; returns a JSON scale assessment the orchestrator uses to select the orchestration flow.

requirements.description: User request describing what is to be achieved.

context.description: Optional recent changes, related issues, or additional constraints.

taskType.description: Type of task requested, determined from the context and the codebase.

purpose.description: Essential purpose of the request, in one or two sentences.

scale.description: Work scale, which selects the orchestration flow the orchestrator runs.

uiImpact.description: Impact on the frontend. A value of significant triggers the frontend design gate.

affectedFiles.description: Files the change is expected to affect.

fileCount.description: Number of affected files, the primary criterion for scale determination.

risks.description: Requirements-stage risks only; the risk register belongs to risk-analyzer.

scopeDependencies.description: Questions whose answers change the scope and scale of the work.

questions.description: General questions requiring confirmation before proceeding.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: frontend-designer
description: Produces three distinct frontend design options for a spec with significant UI changes — each a design document plus a self-contained static HTML mockup at the canonical designs location. Takes specPath and an optional UI scope; returns the design set ID and option list for user selection.

specPath.description: Path to the spec whose UI changes are being designed.

uiScope.description: Optional distilled UI-relevant requirements and constraints from the requirements analysis.

context.description: Optional additional context, such as user feedback on a previous option set.

designSetId.description: Identifier of the generated design set, for example DES-001.

options.description: Exactly three design options, one entry per option.

name.description: Short label for the option, used when presenting choices to the user.

summary.description: One or two sentence pitch of the design approach.

documentPath.description: Path of the design option document.

mockupPath.description: Path of the self-contained static HTML mockup.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: work-planner
description: Converts a spec and a requirements summary into a single structured work plan document with phases, tasks, and dependencies at its canonical location. Takes specPath and the distilled requirements-analyzer output; returns the work plan ID and path.

specPath.description: Path to the specification the work plan is derived from.

requirementsSummary.description: Distilled requirements-analyzer fields: purpose, taskType, scale, affectedFiles and constraints.

designPath.description: Path to the user-selected design option document, when the frontend design gate ran.

mode.description: Whether to create a new work plan or update an existing one.

updateContext.description: Path to the existing plan and the reason for the change. Update mode only.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the generated work plan, for example WP-001.

planOutputPath.description: Path of the generated work plan document.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: risk-analyzer
description: Analyzes a work plan and produces a single risk plan document identifying delivery and technical risks, likelihood/impact assessments, and mitigation strategies at its canonical location. Takes workPlanId and requirements; returns the risk plan path and identified risks.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan the risk plan is derived from.

requirements.description: User request describing what is to be achieved.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan the risks were identified against.

planOutputPath.description: Path of the generated risk plan document.

impact.description: Potential impact of the risk on the project.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: task-decomposer
description: Decomposes a work plan into independent, single-commit-granularity executable task files at their canonical location. Takes workPlanId and planPath; returns the list of generated task files with dependencies.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being decomposed, for example WP-001.

planPath.description: Path to the work plan document.

taskFilePath.description: Path of the generated task file.

targetFiles.description: The task's write set, used by the orchestrator for the parallel-execution disjointness guard.

dependencies.description: Task IDs this task depends on, empty if none.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: task-executor
description: Executes exactly one task file end-to-end — investigation, TDD implementation, and progress ticking — without asking questions. Takes taskFilePath; returns a change summary with modified files, or a blocked response with a typed reason.

taskFilePath.description: Path to the executable task file.

taskName.description: Exact name of the executed or attempted task.

changeSummary.description: Summary of the implementation content and changes.

filesModified.description: Every file the task wrote, consumed by the orchestrator to update the execution manifest.

testsAdded.description: Test files the task created, consumed by the orchestrator to update the execution manifest.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing or out of scope, and what would unblock the task.

name: validation-runner
description: Discovers the project's build, test, lint, and type-check commands from repo configuration and runs the full suite against the changeset. Takes workPlanId and manifestPath; returns per-check pass/fail results and creates a validation remediation task on failure.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being validated.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

summary.description: One-line result summary, for example 142 passed, 0 failed.

allPassed.description: True only if every discovered check was run and passed.

outputExcerpt.description: Relevant excerpt of the failure output, naming the failing tests or targets.

suspectedFiles.description: Manifest files correlated with the failure.

remediationTaskPath.description: Path of the validation remediation task, or null when every check passed.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: quality-controller
description: Reviews the changeset for coding-standards conformance only. Takes workPlanId and manifestPath; produces a quality report, and a QC remediation task when violations are found.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being reviewed.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

violationsFound.description: True if any coding-standards violation was found.

standardsFile.description: Coding standards file containing the violated rule.

ruleId.description: Identifier of the violated rule, for example GEN-001.

qualityReportPath.description: Path of the generated quality report.

qcRemediationRequired.description: True if any violation requires remediation.

remediationTaskPath.description: Path of the QC remediation task, or null when no violations were found.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: code-reviewer
description: Reviews the changeset diff for correctness, edge cases, and design — the peer-review stage. Takes workPlanId, manifestPath, and specPath; returns findings with file/line citations and creates a code-review remediation task when needed.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being reviewed.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

specPath.description: Path to the spec defining the intended behaviour.

failureScenario.description: Concrete input or state that triggers the failure.

remediationRequired.description: True if any finding requires a code change.

remediationTaskPath.description: Path of the code-review remediation task, or null when no finding requires changes.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: security-reviewer
description: Reviews the changeset for security defects — injection, authn/authz flaws, secrets handling, unsafe deserialization, path traversal, SSRF, and dependency risk. Takes workPlanId and manifestPath; returns findings with file/line citations and creates a security remediation task when needed.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being reviewed.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

attackScenario.description: Concrete scenario an attacker could execute.

remediationRequired.description: True if any finding requires a code change.

remediationTaskPath.description: Path of the security remediation task, or null when no finding requires changes.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: risk-reviewer
description: Reviews the changeset against the risk plan to verify mitigations were implemented. Takes riskPlanPath, workPlanId, and manifestPath; produces a risk review document and a risk remediation task for any deviations.

riskPlanPath.description: Path to the risk plan whose mitigations are being verified.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being reviewed.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

riskReviewPath.description: Path of the generated risk review document.

riskRemediationRequired.description: True if any risk deviation requires remediation.

riskRemediationCount.description: Total number of deviations requiring remediation.

riskId.description: Identifier of the risk from the risk plan.

filePath.description: File where the deviation was identified.

remediationTaskPath.description: Path of the risk remediation task, or null when no deviation was found.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: acceptance-validator
description: Verifies post-implementation that every acceptance criterion in the spec is demonstrably met, using the work plan's traceability table and the execution manifest. Takes specPath, planPath, workPlanId, and manifestPath; returns per-criterion pass/fail with evidence.

specPath.description: Path to the spec carrying the acceptance criteria.

planPath.description: Path to the work plan, read for its traceability table.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being validated.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

allCriteriaMet.description: True only if every criterion has the verdict met.

criterion.description: The acceptance criterion, quoted or closely paraphrased from the spec.

evidence.description: File and line, or the test executed with its result. Empty only for unverifiable.

gap.description: For not_met, what is absent or wrong; for unverifiable, what clarification is needed.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.

name: documenter
description: Updates documentation for the changeset — doc strings, API/OpenAPI schemas, READMEs — and produces the changeset summary document at its canonical location. Takes workPlanId and manifestPath; returns the list of documentation updates.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan being documented.

manifestPath.description: Path to the execution manifest, the single changeset source.

workPlanId.description: Identifier of the work plan the changeset belongs to.

changesetPath.description: Path of the generated changeset document.

reason.description: Typed reason, present only when the status is blocked.

detail.description: What is missing and what would unblock the agent, present only when the status is blocked.
